commits.summary: Split examples into demo/ and real-world/, with Commons Numbers #223 as the first real-world example
Run the feature loop seven times on TLA examples
Choose the feature loop's prompt by argument
Add four real-world examples, a fork of JBMC's JDK models for java.nio.charset, and an OutOfMemoryError for absurd arrays in the interpreter
Record the /review-findings decision on a cut-off home path

prompts.text: There is one real-world example in this repository of using the `/verify-bytcode` skill on an Apache Commons library. Refactor the `examples` folder to clearly separate this (and future) real-world e…
Check if any conflicting changes were made to examples -- fold those into your changes if they are valuable, otherwise discard them. When you are done, push the latest to remote.
Continue with adding more real-world examples, from the projects listed in README
Can you fork and update the JBMC JDK model to resolve this? Feel free to clone it locally somewhere for now in the `../code` folder.
One correction: add the forked JBMC library (if you take this path) to the `./libs` folder in this repository, not the parent `../code` folder.
Strongly prefer plain clone for now, we can figure out a more advanced build strategy later
